name: Empty bottle
description: A glass bottle. Smash it, fill it, stuff it.

name: Cloth
description: A clean strip of cotton. Bandages, wicks, a mask.

name: Stones
description: A pocketful of road gravel. Throw them and something listens.

name: Steel tumbler
description: Every kitchen has one. Loud when it falls.

name: Food packet
description: Rice, dal mix, a sachet of pickle. One day.

name: Canned food
description: Heavy, dented, priceless.

name: Flashlight
description: Plastic, two batteries, a weak yellow beam.

name: Batteries
description: A strip of four. More valuable than money now.

name: Power bank
description: Half charged. It will charge a phone twice.

name: UV LED
description: Pulled from a phone-repair shop's tester. Purple.

name: Fuel can
description: A litre of petrol in a water bottle. Don't smoke.

name: Medkit
description: Gauze, antiseptic, paracetamol. A hospital's leftovers.

name: Kitchen knife
description: Your own. Not a weapon. Not yet.

name: Cricket bat
description: Taped handle, a signature in marker. Heavy.

name: Smoke bomb
description: A bottle of something that burns badly. Breaks a line of sight.

name: Noise maker
description: A tumbler of stones on a string. Throw it, run the other way.

name: UV torch
description: A flashlight that glows purple. They flinch from it.

name: Bandage
description: Clean cloth, boiled water. Stops a bleed.

name: Your laptop
description: The office laptop. No network, half a battery. A battery is a battery.

name: Antivirals
description: A foil strip from Ward 4's nurses' desk. It slows it. That's all it does.

name: AMR-07 log
description: A stack of telemetry printouts from the server room. March. Your parser's columns.

name: Medical crate
description: A taped carton from the slot shop's stockroom: antibiotics, saline, gauze.

name: Two-way radio
description: A depot radio with a cracked case. It still hisses.

name: Battery cores
description: Four heavy cells from a service counter. Rathore's engineer wants these more than food.

name: UV emitter parts
description: The tube and the driver board from HIVR's steriliser. They glow faintly in the bag.

name: Pulse Gun
description: A UV tube in a pipe, a battery pack, a trigger from a drill. Twenty charges. One each.

name: Calibration drive
description: A hard drive labelled in pencil: 'AMR cal. — do not wipe.'

name: Meera's keycard
description: A white card on a red cord. Every door under HIVR, Ravi says.

name: Ravi's ID
description: His HIVR contractor ID, the photo from his first week. It gets you through one checkpoint, he says.
